mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS trainerId, u.name, u.tel AS phoneNum, u.profile_img AS profileImg, t.approval_status AS approvalStatus FROM TRAINER t JOIN `USER` u ON t.user_id = u.id WHERE t.gym_id = #{value} AND t.approval_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY t.id DESC
